jobs.description:
Verianis an independent research, evidence, evaluation, and communications agency that helps governments solve public policy challenges by working with citizens and the public realm.  We provide services to government and public sector organizations, drawing on expertise in social research, policy development, and communication.  The agency operates globally, with offices across Europe, Asia Pacific, and the US.  About the role  Data processing analyst  · Remote (EU) · 12-month service contract, with intention to extend   Why this role is different  Verian runs some of the largest and most complex survey programmes in Europe - for EU institutions, national governments of the UK and EU Member States, national statistical offices, and other national and regional public bodies. The data outputs you help produce will directly inform public policy decisions across the continent.  The core of the role is the craft itself: producing accurate, high-quality data outputs in a fast-paced delivery environment where attention to detail matters every day. At the same time, Verian is investing heavily in automation, coding and AI-assisted approaches to data processing, and you will be part of that journey from the start - learning Python, R and AI-assisted techniques alongside the engineers and senior analysts building these solutions.  What you will do  
 Support the processing, validation and quality assurance of survey data across the project lifecycle 
 Produce standard deliverables: datasets, data tables, codeframes and documentation 
 Support weighting, significance testing and statistical analyses under guidance from senior analysts 
 Learn and apply Python, R and automated processing techniques to reduce manual effort 
 Use AI-assisted tools for coding, QA and documentation 
 Help develop and improve automated processing workflows alongside existing tools 
  What you need from day one  
 Strong numerical and analytical skills, and meticulous attention to detail — accurate data is the whole job 
 Experience in a data, analysis or research-related role, or a strong quantitative background (e.g. statistics, economics, data science, social science with a quantitative focus) — direct survey experience is welcome but not required 
 Good command of Excel and general data handling 
 Willingness and genuine appetite to learn Python and/or R - some exposure is a plus, but we will teach you 
 Professional working proficiency in English. Knowledge of German and/or French would be an advantage 
  What will strengthen your application (not required)  
 Exposure to Python, R, SQL, SPSS or other statistical software 
 Familiarity with survey research or survey datasets 
 Interest in AI-assisted coding or analytical tools 
  Expect a structured learning path: training in survey data processing, statistics and coding, with direct mentoring from senior analysts.  What we offer  
 Indicative rate of €2,000–3,000 per month - the final offer will be agreed based on your specific skills and experience 
 Full-time engagement on an initial 12-month service contract (independent contractor or affiliate arrangement), with the intention to extend 
 Fully remote, based anywhere in the EU 
 A place in Verian's global Data Solutions team, reporting to a global manager in London, working on large assignments alongside project managers across Europe 
 Hands-on experience with Python, R, automation and AI-assisted development on real, large-scale programmes - a foundation for a serious technical career 
  The process - quick and simple  One introductory call, which will also cover the technical side; potentially a small practical task; then a fast decision. The work is available now and waiting - we will come back to you immediately, so if this sounds interesting, please get in touch as soon as you can. Salary: 2,000–3,000 Originally posted on  Himalayas
